Get to know me

Sharing financial knowledge with students and young adults.

The person behind the conversation

Hi, I’m Rashad.

My work starts with a simple belief: young people deserve to understand money before they’re expected to make big decisions with it.

My background spans banking, wealth management support, and insurance. Working directly with clients has shown me how much everyday financial choices can shape someone’s options.

I bring that perspective into approachable conversations with students and young adults. My approach uses plain language, familiar situations, and questions that connect financial concepts to everyday life.

What I do

Financial education that meets students where they are.

My financial literacy work focuses on the decisions students and young adults encounter as they gain independence: managing a first paycheck, understanding a car loan, or preparing for an unexpected expense.
